overview: FORGE is a leading construction and maintenance company specializing in a wide range of services including residential and government building construction, metal tank and pipeline repairs, welding, electrical and network wiring, plumbing, HVAC systems, and more. Committed to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction, FORGE T&C EST delivers reliable and efficient solutions tailored to meet the needs of diverse projects across Saudi Arabia. With experienced professionals and a strong dedication to excellence, the company is your trusted partner for all construction and repair services.

OurServicesDes.para: At FORGE T&C EST, we offer a comprehensive range of construction, maintenance, and specialized repair services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. Our expertise covers both residential and commercial sectors, ensuring high-quality results with every project.
list: 🔧 Metal Tank & Pipeline Repair: Expert solutions for repairing and maintaining tanks, reservoirs, and long-distance pipelines.
🏗️ Construction & Renovation: Full construction services for residential and government buildings, as well as remodeling and renovation of existing structures.
⚡ Electrical & Network Installations: Professional installation of electrical systems, network cabling, telecommunications, and lighting solutions.
❄️ HVAC & Plumbing Systems: Installation and maintenance of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, and sanitary systems.
☀️ Solar & Energy Solutions: Installation and repair of solar energy collectors and modern energy-saving systems.
OurServicesDes.footP: With a skilled team and commitment to excellence, FORGE T&C EST ensures every service is delivered with precision, safety, and client satisfaction in mind.

header.title: About Us
header.tagline: Building the future with integrity, innovation, and passion.

paragraphs: Welcome to FORGE — your reliable partner in construction, engineering, interior design, electrical and mechanical works, and general maintenance solutions. We are driven by a core commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, delivering value that lasts for generations.

Since our inception, we have consistently delivered high-performing, efficient, and aesthetically superior projects. Our diverse portfolio ranges from civil and structural construction to turnkey interior fit-outs, MEP installations, solar energy systems, and long-term maintenance services.

Backed by a multidisciplinary team of seasoned professionals, engineers, and technicians, we blend technical excellence with creative problem-solving to meet the most complex client requirements. We believe in forming long-term partnerships and growing with the evolving needs of our clients and communities.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.paragraph: We aim to be the leading choice in Saudi Arabia for integrated construction and maintenance solutions, by fostering excellence, adopting cutting-edge technology, and contributing to the development of urban projects with global standards.

ceo.title: About Our CEO
ceo.name: Mr. Fahad Ayed Al-Qahtani
paragraphs: Mr. Fahad Ayed Al-Qahtani is the inspiring leader behind Forge Corporation. With over twenty years of experience in advanced management, he has developed exceptional skills in team leadership, strategic planning, and overseeing multidisciplinary projects. He has established a culture rooted in integrity, precision, and excellence across all aspects of the company’s operations.

His leadership philosophy centers on building client trust, empowering teams through continuous training and support, and striving for ongoing improvement in processes. Under his guidance, the company has expanded its capabilities to manage complex construction projects, earning the trust of prominent clients and successfully executing pioneering projects that reflect high quality and human-centered design.

With a clear vision and strategic planning, Mr. Fahad continues to steer the company toward growth and innovation, setting new benchmarks in resource management, operational performance, and client satisfaction, thereby ensuring the organization’s sustained success and prominence in the construction industry.

hero_section.title: MATERIAL TRADING
hero_section.description: We are the leading stockists and suppliers of Industrial & Construction Material in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Our extensive network offers a wide range of tools, hardware, engineering goods, and safety solutions.

description: Our network in material trading includes a vast array of Hand & Power Tools, Hardware, Engineering goods, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumental, Lifting, Hydraulic, Industrial chemicals, Lubricants, and Building materials from various brands.

We also supply advanced safety and security solutions, including CCTV, GPS Systems, PWAS Systems, Burglar Alarm Systems, Emergency EVAC, Office Security Systems, and Security Patrol Monitoring Systems.

hand_power_tools.title: Hand & Power Tools
description: Our range of essential hand and power tools ensures safe and efficient maintenance operations. Tools include Adjustable Spanner Wrenches, Roller Clutch & C-Clamps, Crimper, Bender & Formers, Manual Fastener Removal Tools, Nut & Screwdrivers, Magnetizers & Demagnetizers, Hydraulic Rescue Kits, T-Torque Wrenches, Valve Wheel Wrenches, Heavy Duty Wide Roll & Hinged Pipe Cutters, Pliers, Pullers & Separators, Scissors, Shears & Snips, Double Handle, Crank Handle & Mechanical Ratchet, and Sockets from Point Shallow to Deep & Turbo Impact.

We also provide Angle & Bench Grinders, Chisels, Chop-saws & Jigsaws, Circular Saws, Miter Saws, Asphalt Blades, Reciprocating Saws, Magnetic Drills, Diamond Core Drills, Rotary & Percussion Drills, Non-Sparking Brass Sledge, and Rotary & Demolition Hammers.
